components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main command button for save, send, resume, and active decisions.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #2563eb; color: #ffffff; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; padding: 10px 20px; font: 600 14px/1.4 Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background 150ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #3b82f6; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #60a5fa; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Neutral command button for secondary actions and compact toolbar controls.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: transparent; color: #a3a3a3; border: 1px solid #404040; border-radius: 4px; padding: 8px 10px; font: 500 12px/1.4 Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background 150ms ease-out, color 150ms ease-out, border-color 150ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #262626; color: #ffffff; border-color: #737373; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #3b82f6; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-secondary:disabled { opacity: 0.4; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Input Field
components.description: Dark compact field used for search, chat input, settings, and local runtime paths.
components.css: .ds-input-field { width: 100%; min-width: 0; background: #0a0a0a; color: #e5e5e5; border: 1px solid #404040; border-radius: 6px; padding: 10px 12px; font: 400 14px/1.4 Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-input-field::placeholder { color: #737373; } .ds-input-field:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: #3b82f6; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px #3b82f6; } .ds-input-field:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Status Chip
components.description: Micro status label for recording state, batch counts, and session scope.
components.css: .ds-status-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; border: 1px solid #404040; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 4px 10px; color: #a3a3a3; background: #171717; font: 600 10px/1.25 Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.05em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-status-chip[data-state='danger'] { color: #f87171; border-color: rgba(248, 113, 113, 0.6); }

narrative.overview: CueMind should feel like a compact operations surface running beside a live technical conversation. The interface is dark because the user is likely sharing screen space with a video call, IDE, browser, or notes app; it must reduce glare, preserve focus, and let state changes register without turning the product into a visual spectacle. The system is dense, restrained, and task-first.
keyCharacteristics: Dense three-column control-room layout with independent scroll regions.
Near-black canvas with neutral tonal layers and thin dividers.
Geist sans for all product UI, with Geist Mono only for prompt/code-like settings.
Blue as the primary action/focus color, used sparingly.
Flat by default, with depth conveyed through borders, tonal contrast, and state.

rules.name: The Accent Scarcity Rule
rules.body: Blue should occupy less than 10% of any screen. If blue covers a surface, it must represent an action, focus, or selected state.

rules.name: The Semantic Color Rule
rules.body: Red, green, amber, yellow, orange, purple, and category hues are allowed only when they encode system state or suggestion type.

rules.name: The No-Hero-Type Rule
rules.body: CueMind is an app surface, not a landing page. Do not introduce oversized display typography or fluid hero headings into the working interface.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Cards, panels, and columns rest on borders and tonal contrast. If a card needs a shadow to be legible, the surface hierarchy is wrong.

dos: Do keep the three-column control-room structure as the default working surface.
Do reserve blue for action, focus, selected state, and high-confidence source/context surfaces.
Do use neutral borders (#262626 / #404040) to separate panels, cards, and controls.
Do make failure states readable in text, not just color.
donts: Don't make CueMind look or behave like a generic AI chat box.
Don't make CueMind look like a meeting-minutes or knowledge-base tool.
Don't make CueMind look like a decorative monitoring wall.
Don't use gradient text, decorative grid backgrounds, glassmorphism, or hero-metric sections.
Don't use colored side stripes on cards.
Don't exceed 16px radius on cards, sections, modals, or fields.
